verify.note: Consequence probe. Rewritten by LIVE-475 after an adversarial audit found the greps measured SPELLING: they fired on behaviour-preserving reformats and stayed green on behaviour-breaking edits. Two changes. (a) Every source arm reads a COMMENT-STRIPPED, WHITESPACE-NORMALISED copy, and the three arms that pinned exact spacing (`useState<string[] | null>`, the Cancelled confirm on one line, the floor inlined in the .gte call) are now separate arms over the normalised text, so wrapping a line or hoisting a local is no longer reported as a regression it is not. (b) The stacking and floor arms RUN the modules instead of naming them: stackRuns is given two items that abut (one run), two untimed items that merely share a day (two runs) and two TIMED items hours apart (two runs), and seriesUpcomingFloor / adminEventFloorDay are called for a real floor. What the probe still reads rather than runs: the grid's own JSX, the drawer, the Workflow card and the staff form, because a .tsx cannot be imported by a probe (type stripping does not handle JSX) and LIVE-034 forbids a probe spawning the suite; those consequences are measured in the render tests beside them. Mutation-tested 2026-09-23 and each of these trips the arm that names it: stackRuns ignoring areBackToBack; areBackToBack widened to any gap (the OLD probe stayed green); dropping fromDay from the admin read; dropping the .gte floor; deleting the Cancelled confirm; gaps starting []. And three behaviour-preserving edits that used to fail it now pass: the no-space generic, the wrapped confirm, and the hoisted floor local.

append.detail: 2026-11-27 (SCAN-1344 follow-up, owner approved the probe rewrite): calendar-workflow-view.tsx was removed with the public tab's retired team mode, so the Workflow-card arm runs only while that file exists; every other arm is unchanged. 2026-11-27 (SCAN-1345, owner approved the probe rewrite 11-27): the staff calendar was retired; its three arms now read the team calendar: the Details panel says Cancel the Plan on a Plan-linked date (added in the same PR), the quick add offers a Kind, and quickEntry gives a private or unavailable date no Plan.
